import codecs
seen = []
failure = ValueError('guest failure')
fail = False
def recover(error):
    input()
    seen.append((error.start, error.end, error.reason))
    if fail:
        raise failure
    return ('*', error.end - len(error.object))
codecs.register_error('name-boundary', recover)
decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('unicode_escape')('name-boundary')
print(repr(decoder.decode(b'\N{TODHRI ', False)))
print(repr(decoder.decode(b'LETTER A}', True)))
print(repr(decoder.decode(b'\u?\N{CJK UNIFIED IDEOGRAPH-4E00}', True)))
print(seen)
fail = True
try:
    decoder.decode(b'\u?', True)
except ValueError as error:
    print(error is failure)
decoder.reset()
print(decoder.getstate())
print(repr(decoder.decode(b'\N{LATIN CAPITAL LETTER A}', True)))
